description: Rick follows the old routes between Venice and Istanbul through Croatia, Albania, Greece and western Turkey, using seafood, family kitchens and regional staples to uncover the culinary inheritance of the Adriatic, Balkans and former Ottoman world.

s06e01.description: Rick starts in Venice, exploring the lagoon's seafood and the city's layered trading history through dishes such as seafood risotto, gnocchi with spider crab and tiramisu before setting out east.

s06e02.description: Ravenna's piadina provides a final Italian taste before the Adriatic route reaches Croatia, where pašticada, goat stew and lamb cooked under a peka connect coastal cooking with Balkan hinterland traditions.

s06e03.description: After oysters at Ston, Rick enters Albania to meet shepherds and a new generation of chefs, discovering dishes such as lepur comlek and tavë kosi in a country whose food was long hidden from outside view.

s06e04.description: Northern Greece brings Ioannina's veal stifado and chicken pie, prawns around Preveza and Messolonghi, and the vegetable-rich cooking that sits beside familiar souvlaki.

s06e05.description: Across the Peloponnese, Rick follows family cooking and regional staples including rooster stew with hilopites, moussaka and galaktoboureko, finding a Greece shaped as much by inland farms as by the sea.

s06e06.description: The route crosses to Çeşme and western Turkey for Armola cheese, Urla wine and the astonishing breadth of a Turkish breakfast, before Rick cooks the Ottoman classic hünkâr beğendi, or sultan's delight.

s06e07.description: In Istanbul, bluefish from the Bosphorus, pistachio köfte and homely kapuska bring the journey to its final city, where Ottoman, Balkan and Mediterranean influences meet in everyday food.
